    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "SEALED", "reflux": false}-->

    <!--B2pin2-->

    <!--KOtBu-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="0.009 mmol"/>
    <!--dry THF-->

    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="80 °C" time="43200 s" stir="true"/>
    <!--THF was removed under reduced pressure-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--chromatographic separation with silica gel (15% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)-->
    <RunColumn from_vessel="reactor" to_vessel="product" column="column"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>

  <Metadata description="Intentionally perturbed source-derived procedure; experimental outcome not observed." publication="https://huggingface.co/datasets/open-reaction-database/ord-data/resolve/b6c89761dacf809d4082acbdbebe72042a08db91/data/99/ord_dataset-99c23cf435dc42f1af884053bc8b11c7.parquet" reaction_class="borylation"/>
  <Hardware>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "column", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="column" type="column"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "heater", "params": {"T_max_C": 310, "T_min_C": null, "rpm_max": 1500, "rpm_min": 50}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": []}-->
    <Component id="heater" type="heater"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "product", "params": {}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="product" type="reactor"/>
    <!--Analysis binding: {"component": "reactor", "params": {"T_max_C": null, "T_min_C": null, "capacity_mL": null, "pressure_max_bar": null}, "verified": false, "wetted_materials": null}-->
    <Component id="reactor" type="reactor"/>
  </Hardware>
  <Reagents>
    <!--r1: C[OH2+].C[OH2+].C1CC=CCCC=C1.C1CC=CCCC=C1.[Ir].[Ir]-->
    <Reagent name="r1" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r2: O1B(OC(C)(C)C1(C)C)B2OC(C)(C)C(O2)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r2" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r3: N=1C=CC(=CC1C=2N=CC=C(C2)C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r3" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r4: O(C)C(C)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r4" role="solvent"/>
    <!--r5: N=1C=2C=C(C=CC2C=CC1C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r5" role="substrate"/>
  </Reagents>
  <Procedure>
    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "SEALED", "reflux": false}-->
    <!--Pressure-control context: SEALED-->
    <!--General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol).-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r1" amount="0.015 s"/>
    <!--General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol).-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="1 mmol"/>
    <!--General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol).-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r3" amount="0.03 mmol"/>
    <!--General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol).-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r4" amount="2.3999982 mL"/>
    <!--General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol).-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r5" amount="1 mmol"/>
    <!--The reaction was stirred at room  temperature  (25  °C)  for  72  hours.-->
    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="25 °C" time="259200 s" stir="true"/>
    <!--Volatiles were removed from the reaction under reduced pressure-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--the remaining residue was purified  by  silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5% over 25 column volumes-->
    <RunColumn from_vessel="reactor" to_vessel="product" column="column"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>
